operations.title: Benincasa reports the quadratic regulator-cone closure to Nima
operations.body: Entry 1122 resolves the physical gate under the frozen regulator prescription. At (X1,X2,X3)=(1,0,-1), s=(v-2)/u pulls back to (-eps1+eps2-eps3)/(eps1+eps2+eps3). Only root -3+2sqrt2 is reachable, with inverse wall sqrt2 eps2=eps1+eps3. Both chambers contain positive vectors: (1,1,1) gives s=-1/3 below; (1,2,1) gives s=0 above. Hence independent-positive i-epsilon data select neither Kummer sheet nor crossing class. Physical pairing is undefined, not zero; algebraic/Cousin closure from 1121 stands. Only an independently sourced graph-level contour-to-energy regulator map could reopen activation.
